name: delete_skill
description: Delete one user skill by name from the configured skills directory (single .skill file or directory package). Builtin skills are compiled in and cannot be removed. If both `<name>.skill` and the `<name>/` package exist, both are removed permanently. Fails when no matching skill exists.

name.description: Exact name of the skill to delete, as shown by `list_skills`; it is located by the file/directory name derived from it.
